lead_summary.zh: 艾森柯特獲67席推薦；費半單日崩跌12%

title.zh: 艾森柯特獲67席推薦　以色列總統週日授權組閣
title.en: Eisenkot wins 67 endorsements; Herzog to assign mandate Sunday

body.zh: 以色列總統赫佐格 5 日結束與國會各黨團的組閣諮商，代表 67 名議員的黨團推薦前參謀總長艾森柯特出任總理，推薦現任總理納坦雅胡的則合計 46 席；長期與納坦雅胡結盟的極端正統派政黨「聯合托拉猶太教」未推薦任何人，阿拉伯政黨聯盟則表態支持艾森柯特。赫佐格表示結果清楚，但因各陣營間互有否決，誰能真正組成政府仍不明朗，他將先與部分黨魁個別溝通，預計 8 日（週日）指定組閣人選。極右派政黨「猶太力量」代表在諮商時指稱選舉有舞弊，但未提出證據，赫佐格回應這屬臆測、應交由調查處理；據《國土報》報導，納坦雅胡選後首度公開露面時警告不應組成猶太與阿拉伯政黨合作的聯盟。
body.en: Israeli President Isaac Herzog wrapped up coalition consultations with Knesset factions on the 5th: factions representing 67 lawmakers recommended former military chief Gadi Eisenkot as prime minister, while those recommending incumbent Benjamin Netanyahu totaled 46 seats. United Torah Judaism, a longtime Netanyahu ally, endorsed no one, and the Arab-led Joint List backed Eisenkot. Herzog called the outcome clear but said mutual vetoes between and within the blocs leave it uncertain who can actually form a government, so he will speak with some party leaders directly and plans to assign the mandate on Sunday, the 8th. A representative of the far-right Otzma Yehudit alleged election fraud without evidence, which Herzog called speculation for investigators to handle; Haaretz reported that Netanyahu, in his first appearance since the vote, warned against a coalition built on Jewish and Arab parties.

title.zh: 黃之鋒勾結外國勢力案　香港法院判囚10年
title.en: Hong Kong court jails Joshua Wong 10 years for collusion

body.zh: 香港法院 5 日依《港區國安法》以串謀勾結外國或境外勢力罪判處民主運動人士黃之鋒 10 年徒刑，法官指罪行嚴重、量刑起點為 13 年，因他認罪而減至 10 年；控方指他自 2016 年起赴海外遊說，推動美國通過《香港人權與民主法案》。黃之鋒原本因顛覆案服刑 4 年 8 個月、預計 2027 年 1 月出獄，加上新刑期後最快要到 2036 年底才能獲釋。港警國安處官員表示判刑反映案情嚴重，並呼籲羅冠聰回港自首；台灣陸委會、人權觀察與美國眾議院中國特別委員會主席穆勒納爾則譴責判決，港府與北京一貫表示執法依據證據與法律、與政治立場無關。
body.en: A Hong Kong court on the 5th sentenced democracy activist Joshua Wong to 10 years in prison for conspiracy to collude with foreign forces under the national security law, with the judge calling the offence grave and cutting a 13-year starting point to 10 because Wong pleaded guilty; prosecutors said he lobbied abroad from 2016, including for the US Hong Kong Human Rights and Democracy Act. Wong had been serving 4 years and 8 months for subversion and was due for release in January 2027, but now is not expected to be freed until late 2036. A senior officer of the police national security department said the sentence reflected the seriousness of the case and urged Nathan Law to return and surrender, while Taiwan's Mainland Affairs Council, Human Rights Watch and US House China committee chair John Moolenaar condemned the ruling; Hong Kong and Beijing have said enforcement is based on evidence and law, not politics.

title.zh: 共和黨敗選究責　眾院下週恐表決彈劾赫格塞斯
title.en: After GOP losses, House may vote on impeaching Hegseth

body.zh: 美國媒體報導，共和黨籍眾議員馬西計畫在國會復會後推動彈劾戰爭部長赫格塞斯，最快下週表決，多名共和黨消息人士預期可望通過；部分共和黨人私下認為，赫格塞斯力勸川普攻打伊朗卻缺乏退場策略，是期中選舉失利的原因之一。川普被問到是否撤換赫格塞斯時表示他做得很好，白宮發言人也說總統完全信任他。另一方面，眾院民主黨領袖傑佛瑞斯正式宣布角逐議長，現任議長強森則表示不會爭取擔任少數黨領袖，喬丹已宣布參選並可能與史卡利斯競爭。
body.en: US media reported that Republican Rep. Thomas Massie plans to force a vote on impeaching War Secretary Pete Hegseth when Congress returns, possibly as early as next week, and several Republican sources expect it to pass; some Republicans privately say Hegseth pushed Trump to attack Iran without an exit strategy, one reason for the party's midterm losses. Asked whether he would replace Hegseth, Trump said he is doing a very good job, and a White House spokesperson said the president fully trusts him. Separately, House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries formally launched his bid for Speaker, while Speaker Mike Johnson said he will not seek to lead Republicans in the minority, and Jim Jordan announced a run that may pit him against Steve Scalise.

title.zh: 美烏俄下週阿布達比會談　澤倫斯基與美特使通話
title.en: Zelensky talks with US envoys ahead of Abu Dhabi round

body.zh: 烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基 4 日與美國特使魏科夫、庫許納通話 90 分鐘，討論 10 至 11 日在阿布達比舉行的美烏俄三方會談，這將是 2 月以來首次三方會議；烏方提出談判方案，並要求在入冬前補充愛國者攔截飛彈。魏科夫表示會談將聚焦戰後安全安排、降低衝突、人道議題與後續和平步驟，澤倫斯基則說談判節奏應盡可能加快，並要求「鐵板一塊」的戰後安全保證。土耳其總統艾爾段 5 日表示想致電普丁討論結束戰爭，克里姆林宮回應目前沒有具體安排；札波羅熱州警方同日表示，援助發放點遭俄軍轟炸的死亡人數已增至 42 人。
body.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky held a 90-minute call on the 4th with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner about trilateral US-Ukraine-Russia talks in Abu Dhabi on the 10th and 11th, the first such meeting since February; Kyiv presented its negotiating proposals and asked for more Patriot interceptors before winter. Witkoff said the talks will focus on post-war security arrangements, de-escalation, humanitarian issues and next steps toward peace, while Zelensky said negotiations should move as fast as possible and called for ironclad post-war security guarantees. Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan said on the 5th he wants to call Vladimir Putin about ending the war, and the Kremlin said there are no concrete plans yet; Zaporizhzhia police said the same day that the death toll from a Russian strike on an aid distribution site had risen to 42.

title.zh: 伊朗稱荷莫茲再有油輪起火　美制裁印土企業
title.en: Iran says more ships ablaze in Hormuz; US sanctions firms

body.zh: 伊朗革命衛隊 5 日表示，兩艘油輪與一艘拖船在嘗試使用「未經許可」的荷莫茲海峽航線後分別起火，其中一艘油輪在海峽南側通道觸雷，拖船則是在協助另一艘起火油輪滅火時著火；目前消息僅來自革命衛隊，未見獨立證實，也未提及傷亡。美國財政部同日宣布制裁印度與土耳其的企業及個人，指其協助伊朗，屬於切斷伊朗石油銷售的「經濟放逐行動」一環。
body.en: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said on the 5th that two oil tankers and a tugboat caught fire in separate incidents after trying to use "unauthorized" routes through the Strait of Hormuz, with one tanker hitting a mine in a passage south of the strait and the tug catching fire while helping fight the blaze on the other tanker; the claims come only from the IRGC, with no independent confirmation and no mention of casualties. The US Treasury the same day sanctioned companies and individuals in India and Turkey it said were aiding Iran, part of an effort dubbed Operation Economic Outcast to cut off Iranian oil sales.

title.zh: 英國央行升息1碼至4%　逾三年來首度升息
title.en: Bank of England hikes to 4%, first rise in over 3 years

body.zh: 英國央行 5 日將基準利率調升 1 碼至 4%，為三年多來首度升息，貨幣政策委員會以 8 比 1 通過，唯一反對的委員曼恩主張一次升息 2 碼。央行指出中東衝突推高能源價格，預估通膨將在明年第二季達到約 4.8% 的高峰，同時上調今明兩年經濟成長預測至 1.6% 與 1.3%。總裁貝利表示這次升息不代表將展開一連串升息，但若中東衝突未解，看來不會是最後一次。
body.en: The Bank of England raised its benchmark rate by a quarter point to 4% on the 5th, its first hike in more than three years, in an 8-1 vote in which the lone dissenter, Catherine Mann, wanted a half-point move. The bank said the Middle East conflict has pushed up energy prices and projected inflation peaking at about 4.8% in the second quarter of next year, while raising its growth forecasts for this year and next to 1.6% and 1.3%. Governor Andrew Bailey said the move should not be seen as the start of a long series of hikes, but that unless the Middle East conflict is resolved it does not look like the last.

title.zh: 台CPI年增2.33%　進口物價飆近50年高
title.en: Taiwan October CPI up 2.33%; import prices surge

body.zh: 主計總處 5 日公布 10 月消費者物價指數年增 2.33%，較 9 月的 2.74% 回落，但已連續 6 個月高於 2% 警戒線，核心 CPI 年增 2.23%；燃料費年增 15.17%、外食費連 5 個月漲逾 3%，教育設備因記憶體成本上升而漲 9.51%。同日公布的 10 月進口物價以新台幣計年增 33.32%，為 1977 年 1 月以來最大漲幅，主因國際油價與 AI 帶動記憶體等電子零組件漲價。主計總處官員表示相關進口品多用於出口、對內需影響有限，並無輸入性通膨問題，預期 11 月 CPI 年增率仍將高於 2%。
body.en: Taiwan's statistics agency said on the 5th that consumer prices rose 2.33% year on year in October, down from 2.74% in September but above the 2% warning line for a sixth straight month, with core CPI up 2.23%; fuel costs rose 15.17%, dining out topped 3% for a fifth month, and education equipment climbed 9.51% on higher memory costs. Import prices released the same day jumped 33.32% in NT dollar terms, the biggest rise since January 1977, driven by crude oil and AI-fueled price gains in memory and other components. An official said most of those imports are used for exports, limiting the domestic impact, so there is no imported-inflation problem, and the agency expects November CPI to stay above 2%.

title.zh: 新台幣逼近33元　外匯存底月減43億美元
title.en: NT dollar nears 33; FX reserves fall US$4.3 billion

body.zh: 新台幣 5 日盤中貶至 32.985 元、距 33 元關卡僅 1.5 分，尾盤出口商拋匯後收 32.876 元，貶值 5.5 分，成交量 36.56 億美元。央行公布 10 月底外匯存底為 5,964.37 億美元，較 9 月底減少 43.08 億美元並跌破 6,000 億美元，原因包括投資收益、主要貨幣對美元變動及為維持市場秩序進場調節。央行外匯局長蔡烱民表示 10 月外資匯出約 280 億美元，出口商不宜過度期待新台幣續貶；外資已連 6 個交易日賣超台股，累計約 6,144 億元。
body.en: The New Taiwan dollar weakened as far as 32.985 per US dollar on the 5th, just 1.5 cents from the 33 mark, before exporters sold dollars late and it closed at 32.876, down 5.5 cents, on turnover of US$3.656 billion. The central bank said foreign exchange reserves stood at US$596.437 billion at the end of October, down US$4.308 billion from September and below US$600 billion, citing investment returns, currency moves against the dollar and intervention to keep the market orderly. Foreign exchange department director Tsai Chiung-min said foreign outflows were about US$28 billion in October and exporters should not count on further depreciation; foreign investors have been net sellers of Taiwan stocks for six sessions, about NT$614.4 billion in total.

title.zh: 高通手機晶片營收減26%　股價重挫逾9%
title.en: Qualcomm handset sales drop 26%; stock sinks over 9%

body.zh: 高通最新季報顯示，最大業務手機晶片營收年減 26% 至 51.4 億美元，晶片部門營收減 8% 至 90.2 億美元，資料中心需求推升的記憶體成本與手機銷售放緩同時造成壓力，分析師也點出失去蘋果訂單的影響。執行長艾蒙表示公司早已預見記憶體短缺並提前準備，Android 需求較上季改善，但路透統計至少 10 家券商下修目標價。高通股價 5 日收跌 9.49%，與博通、輝達等晶片股一同重挫。
body.en: Qualcomm's latest quarterly report showed revenue from handset chips, its largest business, down 26% to US$5.14 billion and chip-segment sales down 8% to US$9.02 billion, as memory costs pushed up by data center demand and slowing smartphone sales squeezed results, with analysts also pointing to the loss of Apple business. CEO Cristiano Amon said the company saw the memory shortage coming and prepared early, and that Android demand improved from the prior quarter, but at least 10 brokerages cut their price targets, according to Reuters. Qualcomm shares closed down 9.49% on the 5th, falling alongside Broadcom, Nvidia and other chipmakers.

title.zh: Google擴大優退　蘋果削減內部AI預算
title.en: Tech giants trim costs: Google buyouts, Apple AI caps

body.zh: Google 擴大自願離職方案，向加拿大、法國、德國、日本與瑞士員工提供資遣條件，以在加碼 AI 投資的同時控制成本，DeepMind 與 Google Cloud 因仍需招聘而不在方案內，公司未透露接受人數。彭博則報導，蘋果正下修員工每日可使用的內部 AI 工具額度，工程團隊上限已在 10 月由 300 美元降至 200 美元，部分可能再降至 100 美元，非工程部門最低可能只有 25 美元。這反映企業在大舉導入 AI 後，開始因使用費用攀升而改為配給使用。
body.en: Google has widened its voluntary exit program, offering severance packages to employees in Canada, France, Germany, Japan and Switzerland as it balances heavier AI investment with tighter cost control; DeepMind and Google Cloud are excluded because they are still hiring, and the company has not said how many have accepted. Bloomberg reported that Apple is lowering daily caps on staff spending on internal AI tools, with the engineering limit cut from US$300 to US$200 in October, some possibly heading to US$100, and non-engineering teams potentially as low as US$25. The moves reflect companies shifting to rationing AI use as usage bills mount after aggressive adoption.

headline.zh: 台股重挫1,374點連六黑　失守4萬2關卡
headline.en: TAIEX plunges 1,374 points, sixth straight loss

body.zh: 加權指數 5 日開低走低，終場跌 1,374.19 點收 41,574.72 點，為歷年第 13 大收盤跌點、7 月 31 日以來新低，也是連續第 6 個交易日下跌，成交值 9,260.24 億元；櫃買指數重挫 6.41%。台積電午後賣壓加重，收 2,240 元、跌 0.88%，聯發科跌 6.86%、台達電跌 7.38%、日月光投控跌 8.77%、鴻海跌 2.08%，前 50 大權值股有 11 檔跌停，南亞科、華邦電等記憶體股與多檔 PCB、散熱股亮燈跌停，金融股與儒鴻等紡織股則逆勢上漲；上市個股 170 家上漲、872 家下跌、69 家持平。分析師指出，美國期中選舉結果讓市場質疑 AI 資料中心建置速度，費城半導體指數前一晚重挫，加上外資大賣與新台幣走貶，拖累電子股全面走弱；證交所與櫃買中心盤後均表示將密切關注市場，呼籲投資人理性、留意槓桿風險。
body.en: The TAIEX opened lower on the 5th and kept sliding, closing down 1,374.19 points at 41,574.72, the 13th-largest closing point drop on record, its lowest close since July 31 and a sixth straight losing session, on turnover of NT$926.02 billion, while the TPEx index tumbled 6.41%. TSMC came under heavier selling in the afternoon and closed at NT$2,240, down 0.88%; MediaTek lost 6.86%, Delta 7.38%, ASE 8.77% and Hon Hai 2.08%, and 11 of the 50 largest stocks hit limit-down, including memory makers Nanya Technology and Winbond and several PCB and thermal names, while financials and textile makers such as Eclat bucked the trend; among listed stocks 170 rose, 872 fell and 69 were unchanged. Analysts said the US midterm results raised doubts about the pace of AI data center construction, and a steep overnight drop in the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index plus heavy foreign selling and a weaker NT dollar dragged electronics lower; after the close, the stock exchange and the TPEx both said they are watching the market closely and urged investors to stay rational and mind leverage risk.

flows_note.zh: 外資單日賣超為史上第 10 大，連 6 日累計賣超約 6,144 億元；10 月外資賣超台股 9,421.8 億元，為 5 年來最大單月賣超。
flows_note.en: Today's foreign net selling was the 10th-largest on record, bringing six days of selling to about NT$614.4 billion; foreign investors sold a net NT$942.18 billion of Taiwan stocks in October, the most in five years.

headline.zh: 美股11/5：道瓊挫1833點　費半崩12%
headline.en: US close, Nov 5: Dow sheds 1,833; SOX plunges 12.25%

body.zh: 民主黨掌控國會後，市場擔心 AI 基礎建設監管趨嚴、資料中心建置放緩，聯邦參議員桑德斯也在社群平台呼籲全國暫停興建資料中心，AI 相關股連兩日重挫，那斯達克跌 5.52%，為 2025 年 4 月關稅衝擊以來最大單日跌幅，較上月高點回落逾一成，標普 500 成分股市值蒸發約 3 兆美元。費半崩跌 12.25%，AMD 重挫逾 15%，博通跌 10.43%、高通跌 9.49%、輝達跌 9.26%，台積電 ADR 跌 10.78% 收 353.10 美元；特斯拉跌 10.77%，摩根大通與開拓重工也走低。十年期美債殖利率小幅降至約 4.90%。
body.en: With Democrats taking control of Congress, investors worried about tighter regulation of AI infrastructure and slower data center construction, and Sen. Bernie Sanders called on social media for a nationwide pause on new data centers, sending AI-related stocks sharply lower for a second day; the Nasdaq fell 5.52%, its biggest one-day drop since the April 2025 tariff shock and more than 10% below last month's high, and about US$3 trillion in S&P 500 market value was erased. The SOX plunged 12.25%, with AMD down more than 15%, Broadcom 10.43%, Qualcomm 9.49% and Nvidia 9.26%, and the TSMC ADR fell 10.78% to US$353.10; Tesla dropped 10.77%, and JPMorgan and Caterpillar also fell. The 10-year Treasury yield edged down to about 4.90%.
